title: IVG Intense Salts Strawberry Kiwi 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: IVG Intense Salts Strawberry Kiwi pairs the juicy sweetness of ripe Strawberries with the sharp, exotic tang of Kiwi. The result is a lively fruit blend where smooth berry notes are lifted by a bright edge. Blended at 50VG/50PG, this Nic Salt e-liquid delivers consistent flavour, discreet vapour, and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, Strawberry Kiwi is ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) pod kits, vape pens and starter devices. Part of the IVG Intense Salts range, Strawberry Kiwi presents a familiar pairing with clarity and freshness.
